LOST

An independent, non-commercial fan tribute to Lost (ABC, 2004–2010), created by J.J. Abrams, Damon Lindelof and Jeffrey Lieber. Written text and layout are original; character photography, season artwork and stills are drawn from the Lostpedia community wiki and remain the property of their rights holders.

Coverage stops at the end of Season 5 on purpose — nothing from the final season is revealed anywhere on this site.
